records.subject: The first raw-blob manifest replay launched one Git process per entry and exceeded the initial display window before emitting a receipt.
records.recovery: A single git cat-file batch stream replayed all final, owner and content-seal entries with zero mismatches.

records.subject: The raw current-roster display was truncated between bounded output segments.
records.recovery: Strict full-file JSON parsing verified all 222 contiguous rows and projected the exact Ilyra, Auren and terminal assignments.

records.subject: The first planning freeze reached its exclusive commit-message write after staging, but a copied external template already occupied that receipt path. No commit was created.
records.recovery: The plan was unstaged without discarding files, only the four copied external commit-message templates were removed, and the manifest was rebound before one corrected freeze attempt.

records.subject: The corrected planning freeze committed and pushed successfully, then its wrapper failed because the new branch had no matching origin fetch refspec for upstream resolution.
records.recovery: The immutable commit and live remote were preserved; a branch-specific origin fetch refspec was added and the existing branch was linked to its existing remote-tracking ref without another commit or push.

records.subject: The first narrowed tracking recovery fetched the exact remote ref but its compound display still failed when upstream resolution was attempted before the refspec registration.
records.recovery: A scalar config inspection identified the missing branch refspec; the branch-specific mapping was added and the four equality values then matched exactly.

records.subject: The first x1 Method Flow serializer grouped five operations and exceeded the 100000-word per-file ceiling before creating a ledger file.
records.recovery: The same retained result metadata was partitioned into five two-operation ledgers; the successful x1 domain session was not replayed.

records.subject: A manifest build was attempted after the failed flow serialization and correctly stopped because the required flow files were absent.
records.recovery: Manifest construction was deferred until the corrected flow shards and index existed; no stage session or runner smoke was replayed.
